steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Hyaaargh!

steps.name: A Competing Knight
steps.text: Damn you, Infected—with the nerve to—

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Go on, leave. You don't deserve to be here.

steps.name: A Competing Knight
steps.text: Peh! I'll drag you out of the scoring pen at the least!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: —! Ugh!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: That's fine, I've still got my points—

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Is that right? Oripathic filth?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Ungh?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Tch, Ingra...

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: That's it! Brassrust! Keep it up! Get him out of the scoring pen!

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Break his hand! Keep going! Don't let that Infected get away!

steps.name: A Sensible Spectator
steps.text: Shh! Keep it down! Look at the seats over there...

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Huh? Why's she all alone there...? 'Infected Knight seating?'

steps.name: A Sensible Spectator
steps.text: Not too loud. She was looking this way earlier.

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Hah, aren't there divider walls between the seats? She can't hear anything, right? Besides, you think an Infected would have the guts to climb over here to get at me?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: This is a knight's swordsmanship, Ingra. All that blunt movement of yours really is unwatchable.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: *Spit*... Infected refuse... daring to lecture me? Wait until I've flayed you and pulled your bones apart... then you'll regret it.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: (He really is no brains, all brawn. I just need to wait while he loses his cool.)

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: (Oh, here it comes!)

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Goddamned Infected trash—

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: —Trash? Why do I feel like it's you knights, resting on your laurels, who can't stand the heat?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Grgh! He can push me off?!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: No, your tiny little playsword could never... is it Arts technique? Wind Arts? Or just pure driving strength?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Would I ever tell you? Olmer Ingra.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: You—take this!!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: (Wait, what—?!)

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Tch, it really was wind.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: It seems it's only good enough to bolster your movements. Far short of what deranged things the Wind Knight can pull.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: (Analysis? So he isn't just a simple-minded moron...)

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hmph, Infected. That sword of yours has no Arts unit, yet still cast... disgusting. The Arts given to you by the Originium in your organs will not change the outcome of this.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: That rotten Blood Knight is the same. Just because some Infected knights have cobbled together a false renown, he forces the common folk to recognize the Infected?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: The Adeptus Sprawiedliwi have been just too kind to you all. Know how grateful you should be, Oripathic filth.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Grateful?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: To you lot?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hah, such attitude? The Infected crawling and struggling along Kazimierz's lowest layers, you genuinely dare to cast contempt on the knight nobles?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Do you know the price the Infected pay for our legal emancipation?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hah, why should I know? I only know your coming death will be wretched—

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Do you know how brutal a female gloompincer is when it's been snatched from its egg? Do you know, when Infected knights are selected... the tacit homicide that happens?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Oh, 'your coming death will be wretched.' Big words, Olmer Ingra. You just relish in bullying the weak. It's a miracle you have the guts to step into a deathmatch.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: —Have you seen what happens to all the lives deemed cheap? You knight noble filth?

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: There's only five still standing their ground in the scoring pen?!

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Kurde! I spent all my savings on this bet, and that idiot doesn't even touch the pen for half an hour?

steps.name: A Rowdy Spectator
steps.text: Why's there still an Infected? Are they fighting 'Brassrust' Ingra?!

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Hey! Get rid of that filthy asshole! Ingra!

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Ingra! Ingra! Ingra!

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Wh-What was that? An earthquake?

steps.name: A Rowdy Spectator
steps.text: No, no, it's that Infected knight over there... she stomped the ground something fierce just now...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...Tch.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: These dumbasses... starting to gang up on the Infected, huh.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: How's that?! Are you hurting now, Ingra?!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Wha... am I being surrounded?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: ...Infected...

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: You have no right to be here.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Ugh—?!

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Forfeit, Infected.

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: I don't like how Ingra does things, but neither my Knightclub nor my family would stand for the humiliation of an Infected sharing the podium.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You... love a good excuse, don't you...

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Don't get me wrong. Only one can stand in the scoring pen in the end.

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: This is a brawl, Infected, but right now, you've made yourself the prime target.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...Feh.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Heedless wretches... once I dispose of this Infected, you're all next.

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: Sir Ingra... I'm wounded and would be hard-pressed to vie for the title, but at least for the moment, we should work together to topple that Infected slave.

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: These depraved Infected with the gall to talk their tripe at knights. You all know of the disturbance the Infected caused before, don't you?

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: Pinus Sylvestris Knightclub always was a suspicious lot. Rumor has it they orchestrate the illegal Infected congregations.

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: Exploiting the riches from winning alongside us to harm the safety of Kawalerielki, and even Kazimierz in whole? Should we be indulging such action?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...Illegal Infected?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: All I saw was a tragedy of people without a home! A tragedy of people dumped out of the factories, the farms and the beast ranches!!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Less of the row, Infected.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: If that's how you truly see it, you ought to go on your merry way back to the Infected shelters. No need to stay here, overwhelmed as you are.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Let's be brutally honest. You ache to put every knight to death, don't you? You're welling with rage, gasping for vengeance, aren't you?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Then what are you waiting for?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: —You!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Ghakh—hah, hah—

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Cur! I'll cleave your hand off and slap you awake with it!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: (No, I can't stay any longer in this fight, I need to—)

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: Not today.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You lot... Get out of my—

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Ungh?!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Dammit... What are you people doing?!

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: Naught but standing here.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: You have nowhere to run this time!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Gargh...!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Oh-ho, your armor's up to snuff. That blow should've cleaved your spine in twain.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Gakgh... gakgh... *cough*, *cough* *cough*...

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: I don't understand why the Knights Association would allow your lot into the Major. Isn't your blood a deadly toxin?

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Enough.

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Infected, get out of here. Just give up.

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: You've already been gravely wounded. Any more, and you'll never win another match.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: —Shut up!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You... you people... sanctimonious thugs...!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Ugh?!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Sanctimonious. Is that what you think of me?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: We'll see how long you can keep up the sniveling little traitor act. You'll be kneeling, begging for forgiveness...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Hey, where are the judges? What the hell is this?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Are these knights gonna just rig up their own shitshow right here?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: I—

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Ingra! Ingra! Ingra!

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Long live Brassrust! Long live Kazimierz! Long live the knights!

steps.name: A Rowdy Spectator
steps.text: Get that Infected up! Make him get up!

steps.name: A Rowdy Spectator
steps.text: Get him on his feet! Keep him fighting!! Let's see how tough he really is!!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...*Hiss*!

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: What? What the? St... Stay away from me, alright??

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What say I toss you down there? Get you closer to the action? Huh?

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Wait.. you...

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: What are you doing?! You're a KNIGHT and you're gonna assault the audience?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: ...What...

steps.name: A Rowdy Spectator
steps.text: Where's security?! Security! There's an Infected assaulting civilians!!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You sonnovabitch!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Gagh...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Y... You...

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Still have strength in you?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Guh—ulgh... blugh...

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: That's close enough, Brassrust, he's liable to die.

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: He might be Infected, but still a registered knight. We don't need the National Council pestering us over an Infected.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Tch! What are you gesturing at me for?! Huh? Who do you think you are?

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: One of us has to lose, Brassrust. There's only one victor in this match.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Exactly what I—

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: What is this? Wind? You still intend to resist?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hah. You know, an electric fan destined for junk blows more of a breeze than you do, Infected. What's the matter?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...You'll... regret this...

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hoh...

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: Has he a death wish?!

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: The wind's—picked up? He's still got strength?

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Ngh—

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: You!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: All of you...

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Hey, hey, look at the Infected!

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: What's he doing?! Is he casting Arts?

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: You—

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: —Arts? No! He can't keep this up—

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Ingra... and the rest of you!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: None of you have the first idea what the Infected have to go through... Did we get Oripathy because we wanted it?!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Families abandon us. Fellow soldiers abandon us. You people throw us into the beast arenas like trash, to bleed alongside starving gloompincers.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I'll have you—
I'll die here.
Right. This is an arena. A Major arena. But in the end, it was only ever built to hold greater and greater show tournaments.
No.
No matter where it is... what does it matter when an Infected 'has an accident?'
Don't resist, and I really will be beaten, wide awake, to death.
That's right.
I need to resist.
There's nothing left but to resist.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I'll make you... pay in blood...!

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Ugh, the wind's getting stronger...

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: Hmph. If I hang around here, come soon enough, I won't be beating any of you. My Knightclub superiors will understand.

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: I was thinking I'd win by playing the bystander. If there's no chance, I'm out, I'm out! You deal with this yourselves!

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Infected can cast without an Arts Unit. That's unfair.

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: I'll be reporting to Northwood Knight Order, Infected have to be constrained... We should withdraw for now, Brassrust.

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Brassrust?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Not a sound... He wants to kill me, waste his very life on these Arts so he can humiliate me...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: No! You can't run!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hah! Why would I ever run?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: I'll tear your miserable Arts and that face of yours into pieces, and dance with your blood under my boots—!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Come! Unmentionable Infected!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: I'll... do you in.. I'll...
Oh.
When we divorced, was she the one who got the photo album?
Shame. I won't get to see my precious—

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Wha—What happened, right at the end there? Did the wind stop?

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Then...

steps.name: An Excited Spectator
steps.text: Then Brassrust's hatchet... it...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: No! Shit!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: *pant*... *pant*... Such a floundering outburst, and where did it get you?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: What's the matter, Infected?! Spent at the last moment?!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: You mockeries of—

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hold on... is he...

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Dead?

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: The Infected... died?

steps.name: An Ingratiating Knight
steps.text: But––

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Get the medics here! Now! This is an arena! An infection on this scale—

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Brassrust! Get away from him!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: He died...?

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hahah, hahahah... he tried casting that piffling burst of Arts, and died?!

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: This is why you Infected all—

steps.name: A Security Officer
steps.text: Please vacate the arena, Brassrust Knight, sir.

steps.name: A Security Officer
steps.text: The medics are stepping in. When we're sure there's no risk of contagion, we'll transport him in a sealed container.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: ...Tch.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Pinus Sylvestris—! Do you want every knight here your enemy?! Well?!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: —Put him down!

steps.name: A Security Officer
steps.text: We're taking these precautions for the safety of the rest of the knights as well as the audience. Please comply.

steps.name: A Security Officer
steps.text: Brassrust, sir, please make your way out.

steps.name: Brassrust Knight
steps.text: Hmph, filthy knight... I certainly don't want my life ruined by Oripathy...

steps.name: A Security Officer
steps.text: Are you Infected too? Please calm down, this is a Major...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Ugh...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Can't you see he's still got life in him?! Move!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Steady. Are you looking to provoke the Knights Association?

steps.name: A Staid Knight
steps.text: Leave this to the medical personnel—

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: *cough*! *cough* *cough* *cough*—!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: *gasp*...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Let me over!

steps.name: A Security Officer
steps.text: Leave her be... she's Infected too. Get the audience evacuated first.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Heh... not exactly...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Blood loss... least of my problems...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Aches in my infected spots... they're spreading... hurts...

steps.name: A Voice on the PA
steps.text: Dear visitors: there has been an incident in the arena. We ask that you follow staff instructions for a prompt evacuation. The award ceremony will be postponed by two hours.

steps.name: A Voice on the PA
steps.text: We repeat—dear visitors...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Wild Mane.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Go on.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...Please... you have to...

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Sona'll find your wife and girl.

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: Don't worry.

steps.name: A Security Officer
steps.text: Look! The Originium is spreading across him! We can't wait any longer, put him in the container now!

steps.name: Iwona
steps.text: What are you doing?!

steps.name: A Security Officer
steps.text: Preventing infection.

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: ...You... damned...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Iwona!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Remember their faces!

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Remember... These knights... These Kazimierzians... These cold-blooded murderers...

steps.name: An Infected Knight
steps.text: Don't let them get away with it!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: It's your turn. Deal already.

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: What's your rush? Just let me think.

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: What've you got to think about with this few cards left?

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: We now report on an urgent news story—

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: An accident occurred at a capture the flag event held today as part of the Major Show Tournament—

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: —an Infected knight concealed his condition before the competition and sustained heavy injuries during the match, all while forcing Originium Arts—

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: —went into shock partway through the event, and passed away after aid proved ineffective—

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: ...Infected...

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: Passed away? Died? Died on the field?

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: According to reports, medical personnel on the scene have finished cleanup of the field, and the arena will return to normal use tomorrow following decontamination.

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: With only three hours since the incident, the National Council have already received mass complaints, and look to revise the Infected Knights Act—

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: Revise the act? Pull the other one, they're just petrified of owning up!

steps.name: Old Craftsman
steps.text: When the Blood Knight came about, they were pressured to recognize Infected as legitimate. If they fiddle with the laws now, how are they going to save their reputation?

steps.name: Old Knight
steps.text: The question of the Infected's no child's game... you think 'reputation' could affect their policymaking?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Was the knight nobles' 'reputation' ever any worse? Decades ago?

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: Times are different. I can't say I know what they're thinking now, but no matter whereabouts, enforcing the rules takes priority over any objective results.

steps.name: Bald Marcin
steps.text: We've all suffered for it.

steps.name: A Voice on the Television
steps.text: Cleanup has been completed. All knights who took part will be given a medical examination within the next three days—

steps.name: A Voice on the PA
steps.text: With regard to this incident, the Knights Association is paying a correspondingly high amount of attention.

steps.name: A Voice on the PA
steps.text: Currently, several Knightclubs have cosigned a statement to the Association on the accidental deaths of Infected, uncontrollable Originium Arts, as well as the risk of large-scale infection breaking out during the Major...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Haah—!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: No problems, Maria.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Your adjustments to the weapon core are perfect. It's been a long while now since I've wielded something so effortlessly smooth.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah... mm-hm!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: I made them especially based on your past fights after all, heheh.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: If we're done with all the theory, we'll want a little practical combat to try things out.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria, keep to one side.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah... okay!

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: You take it easy now, both of you!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I will.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: My, that's a good look in your eyes, Margaret.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: This is for real now. If you throw, my self-respect will be very sore for it.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Now, then—

steps.name: A Voice on the PA
steps.text: —Accordingly, we have invited numerous experts on knight competition to publish their own views. We now go to the Knights Association Officer-in-Charge.

steps.name: A Voice on the PA
steps.text: Ah. Good morning, people of Kazimierz—

steps.name: A Voice on the PA
steps.text: —Infected can cast without an Arts Unit; this is known to medical science—

steps.name: A Voice on the PA
steps.text: But in the arena, such an ability is 'exceedingly unfair'—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: (Fairness.)

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Fairness, huh.

steps.name: Młynar
steps.text: And surmounting the rulesetters within their own rules? Lunatic ravings.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Ugh...!

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Careful.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Are you alright?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Oof... I—I'm fine, now let go...

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: I'm sorry, it's been a while since I used a weapon with a handle this long. I'm still not quite perfect at exercising it.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: —Ma-ri-a? What are you laughing at?

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Eh? Ah, I'm sorry, sorry.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Margaret.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: You really have changed.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Hm? Have I?

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: I don't mean your appearance. Your hair's all messy now. Come here, I'll comb it straight for you.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Maria, bring the comb over. It's behind your worktable.

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Ah, okay.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Let's sit and take a moment to breathe.

steps.name: Margaret
steps.text: Alright. Thank you.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Honestly... it feels like it's only been the blink of an eye since you left.

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: (The blink of an eye... and you'll be even farther away from us.)

steps.name: A Voice on the PA
steps.text: —According to reports, the deceased Infected appeared to be implicated in the illegal Infected incident. The relevant circumstances are still under investigation.

steps.name: A Voice on the PA
steps.text: The Knights Association promises that an incident this minor absolutely will not affect the course of the Major's schedule—

steps.name: Maria
steps.text: Zofia... that's...

steps.name: Zofia
steps.text: Ingra again, is it? For him to be killing on the field, though...

steps.name: A Voice on the Display
steps.text: —Currently, visitors to events involving Infected knights are asking for the Knights Association to resolve the situation.

steps.name: A Voice on the Display
steps.text: At the same time, 'Brassrust' Olmer Ingra and several other knights who were directly involved in this event have taken interviews—

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Are you listening? Mr. Malkiewicz?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh, sorry, Jewell. Carry on.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes, sir. Actually, they're forms from the Knights Association, with the personal details and noteworthy points for all Grand Knights taking part this time.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: The General Chamber would rather not ruin relations with these stars, so they're hoping we can be more attentive...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Let me see...

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: (They're all established athletes... oh, the Radiant Knight really is in here, too.)

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Does this 'Nightmare Knight' not have a Knightclub affiliation? I thought the Radiant Knight was the only case of an independent qualifying for the Major?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: And besides, 'Nightmare Knight'... Aren't the Grand Knights' titles usually less of a mouthful? And he doesn't have a 'The' either?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: He's not one of the Grand Knights, then? So what's so special about him?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ah, this one... haha. He's been a great pain for the Knights Association to handle. I don't entirely know what's up, but...

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: He doesn't care a single bit about knight titles or any such thing, and brushes off all arrangements the General Chamber makes, but he isn't deliberately disobedient either.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: He's a weird one.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: A weird one, huh?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes, sir, but there's no doubt about his strength. And besides, I don't know why, but it seems some knight families are extremely curious about his identity. They've tried asking the Association countless times already.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: But we're not too clear on what's going on with him either. Things suggest he came from some rural area near Sargon?

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Mr. Malkiewicz?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: ...I understand. You're free to go.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: Oh, one thing, Jewell.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Hm? What is it?

steps.name: Spokesman Malkiewicz
steps.text: I'm still the same Malkiewicz you know... so no need to be so reserved with me. I'm not used to it.

steps.name: A Corporate Employee
steps.text: Ah... as you wish, I mean, understood, Mal—Mr... Malkiewicz.

a.text: How should the National Council rule? With a severe incident on the inaugural day of the Major, what can the Knights Association do to respond?
After this commercial break, we'll be bringing you a live broadcast of the Knights Association press conference.
